scores.evidence: There are three can-do objectives with Bloom levels. Each one has at least 3 questions with objectiveId (o1: q0, q1, q2, q5; o2: q3, q6, q7; o3: q4, q9, q8), and q1 and q5 are at apply level. The rewritten q9 now makes the learner judge both A and B, because options b and c also reject B, so the o3 practice item tests the evaluation it claims to test.

hook-problem sets out a concrete problem in 2 sentences (「CLAUDE.mdに「`.env` は編集しないこと」と書いたのに、Claudeが `.env` を書き換えようとしました。」) and adds the version line. In the ungraded hook-predict, option c now reads 「編集の直前に動くプログラムで、書き込みを止める」, so the answer no longer repeats the prompt's 「毎回確実に」. Option d (Manualモード) is a real near-miss.

The prerequisites list lessons 2, 6 and 7, jq and JSON editing, and s2-setup starts with `jq --version`. The lesson recalls earlier lessons (s1-lead 「第6回のとおり」, s5-lead 「第7回のスキルやサブエージェントは」). s1-config now explains the Prettier command and the incoming JSON before the code (「フックに届くJSONから編集したファイルのパスを取り出し…（8-2で詳しく）」). Definitions match the glossary word for word, and トランスクリプト（transcript） is glossed where it first appears.

measure.mjs prints 「prose 1705 (budget 1,200–2,400) · … est 16.9 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 17)」, and estMinutes 17 matches. Lint reports 0 warnings, every segment has at most 3 defined terms, and s3-pitfall is now 3 sentences. The practice section is still heavy, though: 13 blocks covering two separate tasks (build the .env hook, then evaluate two candidates).

s2 is a complete worked example with subgoal titles, and each step now says why: ex-script 「`exit 2` は「止める」の合図で、標準エラー出力の文が理由としてClaudeに届きます」, ex-register explains `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR`, ex-test says 「JSONの中の `rm` は文字として渡るだけ」. Each step has an observable expect. The practice then fades it (same structure, different matcher and field), and q5 in the exam asks for the same skill on `config/production.yml`.

Inline checks appear in s1, s2, s3, s5 and the practice. q1 is apply, q2 is analyze (`rmdir old` and `cd docs && rm notes.txt`), and q9 is evaluate with a 2×2 option set (A all / A read-only / A none × B in / B out), so rejecting B alone no longer finds the answer. Every wrong option has feedback. One soft spot remains: q3 b repeats the s3-table cell 「ふつうは進み、「hook error」の通知が出る」 almost word for word.

Every misconception in the brief except one appears as a distractor with feedback of 2 sentences or fewer: CLAUDE.md as a guarantee (q0 a/b, q1 a, q7 b), exit 1 blocks (q3 a/c, q5 b), PostToolUse undoes the edit (q6 b), the condition catches everything (q2 a/b/d), 公式なら安全 (q4 d, q8 b) and 社内製なら全部許す (q9 b). The exception is misconception 3 (「`exit 0` は許可」): it appears only as the s3-table cell 「（許可ではない）」 and the diagram edge, with no reason and no question. Also, q8 d's feedback asks the learner to 「ツールを絞ります」 for a server that has no write tool.

s1-lifecycle is a 6-node process diagram with Japanese labels that match the text. The edge 「通す（権限の確認へ）」 now agrees with s3-table's 「許可ではない」. The caption states the takeaway, and the alt text now covers both paths (「通すと、ふだんの権限の確認へ進みます。」). All tables have 2 columns, and there are no decorative images.

The task is authentic and faded. Each step has an expect, and there is a hint ladder (step hints, ex-register troubleshoot, model answer), model answers for both halves (practice-model-script/-settings, practice-b-model, practice-b-model-b) and a 5-item self-check. But the new p-predict hint only says to change `tool_input`, so a learner who follows it pipes the JSON to block-rm.sh and sees `0` instead of the promised `2` (see mustFix).

summary-points (4 points) comes after the exam. summary-next has a reflection question (「あなたのCLAUDE.mdで、本当は毎回必ず守らせたいルールはどれでしょう？」), the next step (第9回) and a descriptive link. There are 7 flashcards, and card-before-install lists the same 6 items as s5-checks. The askTutor suggestions go beyond the lesson (Bash writes, deny rules).

The claims I checked agree with the fetched pages. hooks.md says 「On events such as `PreToolUse`, you see a `<hook name> hook error` notice」 (s3-table), hooks-guide says exit 0 「doesn't approve it」 and 「PreToolUse hooks fire before any permission-mode check」 (s3-zero, q7 d), and mcp.md says it 「prompts for approval in interactive sessions before using project-scoped servers」 (s4-scopes). The version is pinned to v2.1.304, and the brief records the code being run. Two small precision points remain: s5-risk 「自分のアカウントの権限」 for the source's 「your user privileges」, and the claim in hook-predict and s1-lead that hooks are the way to enforce a rule, which leaves out lesson 2's deny rules.

The lesson uses です・ます throughout, the tone is warm and does not pressure the learner (「結果を先に予想しましょう」), there are no banned phrases, and terms match the glossary and the course (Manualモード, autoモード). q8 c now reads 「承認を求められたら」. The ja-editor owns the wording.

The only locale (jp) is complete, the diagram labels are Japanese, the alt text describes both paths, and the one link has descriptive text (「フックの公式ガイド（日本語）」). Plain-text fields such as the checklist labels and the table captions carry no markdown.

mustFix.issue: The new p-predict hint (「例題のテストのコマンドで、`tool_input` を `{"file_path":".env"}` に変えます。」) says to change only `tool_input`. The example test command (s2-test) pipes the JSON to `.claude/hooks/block-rm.sh`, which reads `.tool_input.command`, gets an empty value and exits 0. A learner who follows the hint literally sees `0` where the expect promises 「理由の文と `2` が出ます」, and may conclude that their protect-files.sh is broken.
mustFix.fix: Set the p-predict hint to: "例題のテストのコマンドを使います。`tool_input` を `{\"file_path\":\".env\"}` に、渡す先を `.claude/hooks/protect-files.sh` に変えます。"

niceToHave: hook-predict q0 explanation (and s1-lead): lesson 2's deny rules are also a mechanism that blocks regardless of Claude's judgement (cross-lesson fact 4: Read/Edit deny rules cover the built-in file tools and recognized Bash file commands). Replace the last sentence of the explanation with "このレッスンでは、その仕組みのひとつ、フックを作ります。第2回の拒否ルールも、仕組みで止める方法です。"
s3-zero: misconception 3 (「`exit 0` は許可」) is never corrected with a reason. Set md to "`exit 0` は止めないだけで、許可ではありません。`exit 2` は、どの権限モードでも操作を止めます。"

check-quiz q8 option d: the feedback's remedy 「ツールを絞ります」 does not help with a server that has no write tool. The check that d leaves out is the origin and the author. Use "読むだけでも、Webページに紛れた指示を取り込むことがあります。出どころと作者も確かめてから入れます。"

factual doubt: s5-risk 「自分のアカウントの権限で」 (and the q4 explanation) paraphrases plugins/security 「with your user privileges」, which refers to the OS user, not a Claude account. Consider "プラグインは、あなたのPCのユーザー権限で、任意のコードを実行できます。"
practice-steps p-script: it has no troubleshoot, although registering the second hook can fail the same way as the first. Add troubleshoot "`/hooks` に出ないときは、例題の②と同じく、JSONのカンマと `chmod +x` を確かめます。"
s2-steps ex-script: the lesson never says to create the file. Prepend to md "エディターで `.claude/hooks/block-rm.sh` を作り、上のスクリプトを保存します。"

s4 (claude mcp add, scopes) is still not covered by any objective or question, yet summary point 3 and card-scopes are about it. Tie it to o3 (for example, a q8 option about committing to `.mcp.json` at `project` scope rather than `local`) or shorten the summary point.
s3-check q3: option b repeats the s3-table cell. Asking it as a log to read (「`exit 1` のフックを書いたのに、hook error の通知が出て `.env` が書き換わりました。原因は？」) would turn it into retrieval rather than recognition.

practice holds two ideas (build the .env hook, then evaluate two candidates) in 13 blocks. If the section structure is revisited later, splitting the candidate evaluation into its own practice section would ease the load. This would be a structural change and would need a full review.
summary: This is a full review: review-scope.mjs exited 1 because 22 of 49 blocks changed (45%, over 30%). Both round-1 must-fix items are gone. q9 now crosses A's and B's judgements, so a learner cannot answer by rejecting B alone, and s3-pitfall is down to 3 sentences. Most round-1 suggestions were applied (reasons in the steps, the diagram edge 「通す（権限の確認へ）」, the s1-config explanation, practice-b-model-b). One fix remains: the new p-predict hint sends the learner's test JSON to block-rm.sh, which prints 0 instead of the expected 2; the hint must also say to pipe to protect-files.sh.
